synopsis: The framework aims to provide confidence across conditions, configurations and environments, including more than 100 job-site types, but the corpus warns that a collision system cannot be assumed to handle every site–machine–weather combination [f31, f7508, f3599]. Published off-road intervention launches have deliberately narrow scopes, so the recommended strategy is restricted release followed by widening through evidence gates; Volvo CE's January 2023 example is reverse-only at 3–15 km/h with braking lasting 2–3 seconds [f10434, f379, f1238]. Validation coverage should be organized around an operating-domain taxonomy, a scenario catalog and parameterized scenario families, rather than site counts or one Cartesian matrix; relevant dimensions include surface, slope, objects, weather, light, machine model and sensor pose [f119, f4063, f11498]. On-road standards offer transferable structures, not off-road content, and no heavy-machinery equivalent of ISO 34502:2022 was found for operating-envelope and scenario coverage, leaving the programme to define its own taxonomy [f6642, f10334, f10335]. A programme starting in October 2026 could realistically have an operating-domain definition and scenario catalog working by mid-2027, with ownership retained in-house and the final plan explicitly documenting coverage, exclusions and the envelope of its safety claim [f63, f8797, f10155, f10184]. Simulation also needs its own credibility and applicability envelope: the cited on-road approach permits virtual ODD coverage only inside the validated envelope, while validation across mine conditions remains an outstanding need [f7998, f7841, f3601].
